description: Theme backdrop score recipes. polarity +1 = up is good for the theme, -1 = up is bad, 0 = unused. Scores recompute when contributing packs update (e.g. end of lab_economics job).

signal.note: Map YoY % into [-1, +1] by clipping at ±yoy_clip_pct, then score = 50 + 50 * weighted mean of (polarity * signal).

themes.label: Lab backdrop

components.rationale: Lab services selling prices rising → pricing power / healthy demand.
Industry hiring → capacity expansion / demand for lab work.
Quarterly confirmation of diagnostic-lab employment trend (NAICS 621511).
Reagent import volume as a soft activity proxy for IVD throughput. Ambiguous if stockpiling; medium-low weight.
Import dollars mix volume and price; keep low weight as secondary activity signal.
Domestic IVD/reagent producer prices up → input cost pressure for lab operators.
Import $/kg up → reagent input cost pressure.
Lab hourly wages up → labor cost pressure (can also signal tightness/demand; down-weighted).
Quarterly avg weekly wage for diagnostic labs → cost confirmation; lower weight vs monthly AHE.
Broad health-care compensation — noisy for labs specifically; low weight cost overlay.
Ticker-local (CSTL). Use later as ticker overlay on this theme score, not in the shared theme backdrop.
Ticker-local (CSTL). Same — overlay later, not theme backdrop.

themes.notes: Framed for diagnostic lab / early-detection operators (sell tests, buy reagents). Pure IVD reagent manufacturers may want flipped polarity on supplies/import prices later. TX QCEW is ticker-local and intentionally omitted from the theme score.

themes.theme: Space Supply Chain '26: Space Launch & Orbital Logistics

NSSL/launch + CLPS keyword awards (sum) rising → procurement demand.
Theme-member recipient awards (sum) rising → named-universe US federal demand.
Broad US defense spend tailwind (NSSL / dual-use).
Elevated geopolitical risk → national-security space launch demand.
